method: Static gravity projection at the seat, rigid sweep of the whole seated pipe from its carry seat toward each opening against every other reserve, and the free-piece receive and sled trials (evidence/field-trials.json: stick-slip friction, so a seated pipe holds statically) for dynamic capture, power loss and the isolation of each retaining member.

pushBack: lower and upper treads in the worm-locked bite (front)
check flap and its rear stop (rear)
side walls 10.2 mm from the pipe ends (+/-Y)

forward (+X) into the nip.note: no rigid obstruction within 400 mm: the rigid roller cores clear the pipe through the throat; the forward stop is the compliant tread squeeze, qualified by the receive and sled trials

powerOff.holder: Self-locking worm: the unpowered nip cannot be back-driven

escapeControl.result: check flap removed, gently settled pipe, 8 g toward the inlet: 1/2 retained
escapeControl.firstOpening: rearward up the floor toward the inlet

isolation.worm: Free-turning rollers: 3/4 adverse receives seat; worm locked: 16/16 at 40 N/mm. Carry sled with free rollers from a free-settled seat: 1 g 2/2, 3 g 2/2, 8 g 2/2.
isolation.flap: No flap from the received seat: 1 g 2/2, 3 g 2/2, 8 g 2/2; from a gently settled seat: 1 g 2/2, 3 g 2/2, 8 g 1/2
isolation.hood: No hood: 4/4 adverse receives seat (baseline 4/4); peak rise with the hood 0.74 mm. Not shown to earn its place in this model.
isolation.tread: 10 N/mm tread: 8/16 receives seat clear of the throat (4 pass through, 4 stop in the throat); 40 N/mm: 16/16.

findings.text: Tread stiffness decides receive custody: passing value 40 N/mm per roller, failing value 10 N/mm, same arrivals, e and mu. Measure the installed bite stiffness of the 35A wheel stack before G1.
Carry custody in the model rests on static friction in the locked bite and on the flap for a gently settled pipe at 8 g; both need G3 on the bench with the real wheels and reducer.
No seated-pipe sensor or lip-deployed sensor is placed; the eject interlock needs both.
